# seerr_about (Data Source)

Get Seerr server stats and information.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "seerr_about" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `app_data_path` (String) The application data path.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `total_media_items` (Number) The total number of media items.
- `total_requests` (Number) The total number of requests.
- `tz` (String) The timezone of the server.
- `version` (String) The current version of Seerr.
